# --- SwiftyEdit upload folder (do not edit) ---
# Written by the installer and by updates (see se_write_upload_htaccess_files()
# in install/php/functions.php) - a second line of defense next to the rules in
# public/.htaccess, so it also applies if that file is outdated, e.g. after a
# manual update. To keep own rules here, remove the first line - the file is
# then no longer replaced.

# never execute scripts from upload folders - they only hold images and files
<IfModule mod_rewrite.c>
    RewriteEngine On
    RewriteRule \.(php[0-9]?|phtml|phar|pht|phps|cgi|pl|py|sh)$ - [F,NC]
</IfModule>

# SVG is XML and may contain scripts - when an SVG is opened directly it must
# not run anything
<IfModule mod_headers.c>
    <FilesMatch "(?i)\.svgz?$">
        Header set Content-Security-Policy "default-src 'none'; style-src 'unsafe-inline'; img-src data:; sandbox"
        Header set X-Content-Type-Options "nosniff"
    </FilesMatch>
</IfModule>
